newsitem.title: USA: Amtrak, Burlington Northern sign new deal.
newsitem.headline: Amtrak, Burlington Northern sign new deal.

text.p: Amtrak and Burlington Northern Santa Fe Corp said on Tuesday they signed an agreement to allow the nation's passenger railroad to operate on Burlington tracks over the next 15 years.
The new contract replaced previous agreements between the two companies that spanned 25 years from 1971, they said in a statement.

While the terms of the contract were not disclosed, Burlington Northern said it covered Amtrak's right to services. It also established emergency procedures, performance standards, and rules about platform usage.
